instruction: Add 'finance@outlook.com' as a CC recipient to the email draft and save it.

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding a CC recipient to the email. Evaluator checks if 'finance@outlook.com' appears in the Cc field of the draft. Similar difficulty to original task (adding one field vs adding one attachment).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator semantically checks the correct requirement: verifies that 'finance@outlook.com' appears in the CC field of the saved draft
Expected value is semantically correct: 'CC added!' confirms the CC field was properly added
